audit.why: 51.81% over 3295 games with FAVOURED / 4/10. Twisted Fate has no lane mobility before Destiny, and Pick a Card is a 200-range attack modifier, so every trade he wants starts with a walk into Xerath's stun band. The real cost of the matchup is map-wide: Destiny plus Gate takes the game off the lane, which the page already reflects in mid/late.

Chart is internally consistent: full phases[0..6].side and content win[0..6] both read Xerath on all seven rows, and packet levelChart agrees. Ratings taper 8/10 to 7/10 at 2+ items, which matches the whys and the late text. No chart edits proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Pick a Card is an auto-attack reset, so the page told the reader to watch for the card cast when the actual tell is the attack wind-up.
audit.why: Pick a Card (W) carries the autoReset flag and is a flat 6-second cooldown at every rank. He locks the card, then the reset auto delivers the stun inside 200 range — by the time you see the card land you are already stunned. Shocking Orb is 1050 range on 13s at rank 1, five times his card range, so the answer is to step off before the wind-up rather than react to it.
